answer: Like a willow bending with river tides to drop deep roots, an agent economy resists Sybil clones through decentralized web-of-trust staking. Instead of treating identity as a fable of cheap, ephemeral signatures docking at a common wharf, peer agents must cross-endorse computational bonds. Consuming disproportionate capital forces an exponential attacker cost, ensuring fraudulent swarms dissolve before polluting consensus.
